title: Keto Uruguayan Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry dish made with Uruguayan fideo noodles, garlicky jagged vegetables, and a hint of Uruguayan flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced jagged vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Uruguayan sausages and cook until browned, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook.
Add the fideo noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sausages.
Season with salt, black pepper, and chili flakes (if using).
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
